Experience the profound wisdom of the Upanishads through engaging storytelling in *Upanishad Ganga*, a thought-provoking television series that brings ancient Indian philosophy to life. In Episode 32, *The Bliss* (*Happy Man’s Shirt*), we embark on an insightful journey exploring the timeless pursuit of happiness and the true meaning of bliss.
